Runes › Sorcery

Summon Aery

SorceryKeystone

Damaging enemies sends Aery to deal a little damage, and helping allies with abilities sends Aery to shield them.

What it does

Damaging enemy champions with basic attacks or abilities sends Aery to them, dealing 10 - 50 based on level (+0.05 AP) (+0.1 bonus AD). Empowering or protecting allies with abilities sends Aery to them, shielding them for 20 - 100 based on level (+0.05 AP) (+0.1 bonus AD). Aery cannot be sent out again until she returns to you.

When to take it

Take it on supports and poke champions who hit enemies or shield allies often. Aery has to fly back to you before she can be sent again.

Good on

Janna Lulu Karma Soraka Nami

Other Sorcery keystones

Arcane Comet Stormraider's Surge Deathfire Touch
